notes.title: Finding the style of Reclaim The Living.
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello survivors![/h1]

We wanted to give you an update on the development of Reclaim the Living.
We've been hard at work developing the game systems and finding the visual style for the game.

Our goal is to bring you a fresh new take on the horde-survivor genre and we wanted the look of the game to reflect that.

[h2]Leveling Up[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943441/7967982875b6c7716368e4b6763dbf5fe881fd52.png[/img]
Since the beginning of last year, when we first built the prototype for this game, we've released our first game on Steam, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658690]Supurr Cat Cafe[/url], and we've learned tons!

With these new found skills, we decided it was time to give it our all for Reclaim The Living to look awesome.

We hope you love the new aesthetic as much as we do.

[h2]Adding a new Dimension[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943441/bbc52aa0fdce6c3f1a2ec6774592e12868cf7688.gif[/img]
We've gone 3D! Well... [b]2.5D![/b]

This means the game is now in a 3D environment but still making use of the, full of personality, 2D art! With this new setup we get to use things like perspective, lighting and 3D models!

[h2]The Doctor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943441/b46ebca61befe8e3a9f149def18c9c917387393b.gif[/img]
We also took this opportunity to give our quirky doctor a glow up. Look at him go!

Looking forward to show you more.
Stay tuned and remember to give the game a [b]Wishlist[/b] if you haven't already!

Much love from us 2 Nerdy Nerds,
Bernardo & Selene

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943441/eb3bd20f22ae82d4db3f201b526e1c0385265f13.png[/img]
